articleTitle: The Impact of Organizational Empowering Leadership Behavior on Individual Adaptive Performance: Cross-Level Mediation Effect of Organizational Psychological Empowerment
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: This study explores how the internal organizational empowering environment has an impact on individual adaptive performance? Based on the theory of empowering, it builds the concept model of organizational empowering leadership behavior, organizational psychological empowerment and individual adaptive performance, and aims to analyze the impact of organizational empowering leadership behavior on individual adaptive performance through organizational psychological empowerment. Through the questionnaire of 420 staffs from 9 large-medium-sized enterprises of three provinces in Northeast China, the researcher verifies the hypothesis and gets the following conclusion: Organizational empowering leadership behavior has a significant positive impact on individual adaptive performance; Organizational empowering leadership behavior has a significant positive impact on organizational psychological empowerment; Organizational psychological empowerment would play a cross-level mediating effect between organizational empowering leadership behavior and individual adaptive performance, and it is a full mediation. The conclusion of the study enriches the relevant research results of the influence of the internal empowering environment on the individual adaptive performance, and it has a good reference for the management practice of improving individual adaptive performance.

articleTitle: The Influence of Brand Extension on Customer Equity Value of Parent Brand Based on System Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: System dynamics method is used to study the influence of the brand extension on the value of the parent brand customer asset. The system dynamics simulation model is constructed. The simulation model is analyzed by the questionnaire. The results show that, regardless of the enterprise to take high or low fit brand extension, similar “U” type growth is presented on the extension of the parent brand customer asset value, relationship quality of driving force characteristics, and mouth and brand equity products. Consumption model shows a linear growth, but the growth rate is different. Compared to the low fit extension, high fit brand extension after the parent brand customer asset value, relationship quality, word of mouth, brand equity and consumption demonstration of the growth rate is greater.

articleTitle: Defining Criteria for Completeness of Entrepreneurial Ideas
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: This article examines aspects of the assessment and selection of entrepreneurial ideas. Since there currently exist a fairly large number of evaluation mechanisms and selection criteria for entrepreneurial ideas, the article presents a system for initial “filtering” of these ideas by fairly simple criteria. The proposed evaluation system will allow an idea to be evaluated quantitatively (using a points system) for “viability”, and thus compared with other ideas. The selection system proposed will make it possible to take to the “second level” (that of consideration and approval) only those ideas that are truly feasible under given economic, market and social conditions. The system presented is based on a number of different approaches to idea evaluation, and these are also analyzed in the article. In addition, the article gives an overall description of approaches to the understanding of the entrepreneurial idea and its role in the organization and effectiveness of business activity.

articleTitle: A Study on Factors Affecting Students' Entrepreneurial Intentions in HIT
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: This thesis is based on the theory of planned behavior, and the influence of entrepreneurship education on College Students' network entrepreneurial intention. Study found that entrepreneurship education of undergraduate network does pioneering work will have significant positive effects, and support environment of financial support plays a moderating effect between entrepreneurship education and entrepreneurial intention, and non-venture financial support in between entrepreneurship education and entrepreneurial network will not up regulation effect. Thus, to improve the system of entrepreneurship education for college students to improve the entrepreneurial environment, and enhance the students' entrepreneurial intentions.

articleTitle: Modeling for the Measurement of Smart City
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: In this paper, models are built to imply smart growth theories into the measurement of smart cities. Firstly, three E's of sustainability are decomposed into eight quantitative indicators and their weights of importance are determined through AHP for the construction of the overall metric. Secondly, this paper uses fuzzy comprehensive evaluation to grade specific data into three levels and eventually obtain a specific score of the overall metric. By establishing AHP-fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model which combines Analytic Hierarchy Process and Fuzzy Evaluation Method, we can easily measure the success of smart growth of a city.

articleTitle: Research on Impacts of Manufacturing Industry Upgrading to Low-Carbon Technology Breakthrough Innovation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: The innovation ability and application level of low-carbon technology have become an important index to reflect the level of national manufacturing industry's competitiveness. In the context of the comprehensive acceleration of Chinese new industrialization process, the manufacturing industry must keep up with the needs of the situation, take the initiative to upgrading the production process technology, vigorously promote low-carbon technology breakthrough innovation, help Chinese manufacturing upgrading and transformation, promote industrial structure optimization, and achieve a higher contribution rate of national economy. In this paper, manufacturing industry upgrading and low-carbon technology breakthrough research were chosen as the study objects, impacts of manufacturing industry upgrading to low-carbon technology breakthrough innovation are discussed by using structural equation model. It is concluded that manufacturing industry upgrading can promote low-carbon technology breakthrough innovation, to provide ideas and suggestions for promoting low-carbon technology breakthrough innovation.

articleTitle: Contents
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Part One Strategy and Innovation Management

articleTitle: Passengers' Intention to Use LBS in Metro Emergencies
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: With the rapid growth of mobile networks, scholars around the world have tried to cover this gap by using location-based information services. LBS is able to transfer emergency information between metro passengers and emergency management department through mobile networks in direct and efficient way. However, passengers' intention to use LBS in metro emergency will have a great impact on the actual operation. As a result, this research attempt to find out the factors, which affect the using of LBS in metro emergency situation. A model based on TAM is constructed by literature review, with external factors such as information quality, system quality and risk perception. Questionnaire is also established to measure the adaptability of the model in the specified problem by structural equation modeling. The research results show that information quality of LBS has a great impact passengers' perceived usefulness, and indirectly affect intention to use. System quality of LBS has a great impact on passengers' perceived ease of use, which will directly and indirectly affect intention to use. Passengers' risk perception of metro emergency has the strongest affection on the intention to use LBS, and it will also affect the intention to use indirectly through affecting perceived usefulness. If management department wish to use LBS to manage emergency information, they should try to promote the information quality and system quality of LBS systems. And they also should try to increase passengers' risk perception of metro emergencies.

articleTitle: Innovation Management Mechanism Comparative Study on China-USA-Russia National Defense-Related Science and Technology Industry
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: This current study is designed to compare the different mechanisms between China and foreign countries. Analyzing the national mechanisms of the USA and Russia can promote the development of revolution of national defense in China. Drawing upon previous studies associated with innovation management of national defense-related science and technology in China and foreign countries, this present study conducts endogenous and exogenous comparative studies and has significant effect on innovational management for China's national defense technology industry.

articleTitle: A Partner Selection Strategy of Industry-University Collaboration Based on Social Capital and Network Risk
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: University-industry collaboration is one of the fundamental national policies to build an innovative country in China. It has significant implications to select the appropriate partners for the success of University-industry collaboration. Firstly, the paper introduces social capital and network risk to analyze the partner selection of the University-industry collaboration. Social capital is considered as the attribute of participant itself in the University-industry collaboration, and network risk is used to measure the risk among the partners. Then, we put forward the objective function on the basis of quantization of social capital and network risk. Meanwhile, the strategy of partner selection of UIC is proposed in two cases. Finally, an empirical experiment is given to test the feasibility and validity of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Visual Matching Based on Multi-Agent Under LDP Mode
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: The main purpose of the paper is to give a framework of transaction simulation. It provides a visual platform to simulation the matching transaction progress in the Swarm software. The visual simulation platform is based on the LDP (Large Direct Purchasing) mode in electricity market. The visual transaction is between the electricity generators and large direct users, who participate in a game determined by declaring the quantity and the price in the transaction of the electricity quantity and price under the action of the market rules. The order list, which was established by the transaction, can form a reasonable network connection under the physical constraints to fulfill the distribution of benefits. In the simulation procedures, any actions of the power generator will affect itself as well as the industry's marginal revenue and total profit, and will make the generator to determine its own production quantity or price in predicting other generators' action and the impact of such action on themselves, as well as the impact of this reaction.

articleTitle: Leading Sectors and Energy Consumption in China
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: With China's deepening industrialization process, research on economic structure and leading sectors contributes to grasp the industrialization law. Based on the intersectoral linkage theory, this paper utilizes input-output table to calculate IPD (index of power of dispersion) and ISD (index of sensitivity of dispersion), selects the leading sectors in different phases, and explores their changing tendency. Moreover, the total energy consumption and consumption structure of the leading sectors are also analyzed. The emphasis is placed on the intersectoral linkage and energy consumption structure of the largest energy consumer-iron and steel industry. The analysis on the leading sectors and their energy consumption provides a feasible solution for studying industry structure change and energy security in the late phase of China's industrialization and post-industrialization process.

articleTitle: The Study on Continuous Cooperation Mode in Virtual Organizations Based on Projects: A Case Study of Biogen Idec Company
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: This study selects Biogen Idec Company which is a leader in biotechnology industry as the case and analyzes its continuous cooperation mode in virtual organizations. Specifically, we investigate the mode involving multi-level cooperation, seeking potential cooperative projects and continuously providing post-supports to cooperators. The findings show that the continuous cooperation mode is proactively seeking project resources based on the expected performance with the aim to expand market demands, and this mode is also a deep exploration for innovating corporate operation and maintaining market stability. However, this mode requires companies to competently subdivide projects and re-integrate the divided projects. Finally, we discuss the feasibility of this mode applied in corporate operations and implications for Chinese companies on establishing virtual organizations.

articleTitle: Using DEMATEL to Analyze Interrelationships of Risks Faced by Enterprise in R&D Network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Since more and more enterprises tend to form R&D collaboration with other enterprises, thus if a risk of the cooperative enterprise occurs, it may trigger some potential risk of the enterprise. The related research on risks faced by enterprise has been mainly focus on the categories of risks and how they interrelated with each other. However, these researches ignore that most risks are not only interrelated with the enterprise but also interrelated with some risks of the cooperative enterprises. In this situation, it is more challenge to manage risk for enterprise. Therefore, effectively managing risks interrelated is important to the success of R&D activity. To address this gap, this paper groups risks faced by enterprise in R&D network based on the literature review, and proposes how to use DEMATEL approach to analyze the complicated interrelationship of risks considering both the risk inside the enterprise and risk of the cooperative enterprise.

articleTitle: Design and Management of Matching HUB Event as Nobel Innovation Creation System
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Novel innovation creation system, Matching HUB is proposed. The Matching HUB system was designed to facilitate the simultaneous creation of multiple new products and businesses leading to innovation. A series of Matching HUB events have been held in Kanazawa, which become greater as the events continued to be held. The events have created numerous collaborations by the effective management of University coordinators. The expansion of the Matching HUB event across Japan has already started from Kumamoto and planned to Otaru. The concept of Matching HUB system has been recognized as useful and valuable managed by university for creating the innovation. Furthermore, creating a strong network of various Matching HUB events will lead to the activation throughout Japan.

articleTitle: The Impact of Local Context on the Consumer Choice for Heterogeneity Preferences Product
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Unlike the traditional theoretical preferences hypothesis, which holds that consumer preferences are stable, invariant, consistent and transferable, behavioral economists argue that the preference forming process is not independent. Such a process in a local context is a heuristic one. Existing research has verified the local context effect with homogeneity of consumer preferences but has not explored the effect with preference heterogeneity, which is ubiquitous in perception and judgment. This research contributes literature by investigating whether and how local context affects consumer purchase intention for heterogeneity using a product experience experiment. Cooperating with one of largest retailers in China, we test the purchase intention of its customers for different heterogeneity products combination. The results show the following. In terms of the heterogeneity preference, when offered two products with contrastive attribute values together, consumers show a more positive intention for both products than the intention for the two when offered either one of the two respectively. Theoretical and managerial applications are also discussed.

articleTitle: Research on Fuzzy Evaluation of Modular Construction Quality Based on Combined OWA Operator
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Modular building has beinga national strategy to facilitate the development of economy and society in China. In order to control the quality of modular building, we introduce a set of scientific construction quality evaluation methodology modularto evaluate and control the quality. Hence, this report will point out a fuzzy evaluation model of modular integral construction quality based on the combination of OWA operator weights. The methods from a practical point of view, analyzes the construction quality of prefabricated construction, modular construction quality evaluation index system is established; in consideration of the modular construction of uncertainty. A combination OWA operator objective weighting method and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method combining, assembled monolithic construction quality of the final comprehensive evaluation values are obtained. Finally, by taking a project as an example, the feasibility and effectiveness of the model are verified.

articleTitle: R&D Partner Selection Model and the Formation of Industrial R&D Networks Based on Cooperative Attractiveness
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: In this paper, we model the formation of R&D networks as they emerge from bilateral collaborative decisions. We provide an agent-based model of R&D partner selection and investigate the formation of industrial R&D networks. Different from previous literature, we generate the model based on the objective existing cooperative attractiveness and strategic motivations for partner selection and focus on the role of R&D capabilities of organizations and the logic distance between potential bilateral collaboration. We find that the new model can replicates the network structure well, and two features are central to the R&D network formation: importance of R&D capabilities of agents and the importance of logic distance between agents. The networks forcing by the partner selection model are performing an approximate power-law distribution.

articleTitle: Study on Financial Impact on the Human Health from Residential Building ETICS in QINGDAO
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: In order to determine the influence of external thermal insulation composite system on human health, this paper applied information retrieval method to predict the density of pollution factor PM2.5 which is related to ETICS. According to the human health dose-response relationship calculate the health costs. An example of residential in Qingdao is showed up to calculate healthy cost of the ETICS, compared healthy cost with none ETICS residential, the results proved the economic effect of using ETICS to residential is good.

articleTitle: Study on the Relationship of Guanxi, Knowledge Sharing and Innovation Behavior
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Based on the Resource-Based View theory, this paper explore the relationship of Guanxi, knowledge sharing, and innovation behavior, and knowledge sharing, is divided into explicit knowledge sharing and tacit knowledge sharing, as mediated variables, then the mediator role of knowledge sharing is inspected in the relationship of Guanxi and innovation behavior. Results show that Guanxi has significant positive impact on explicit knowledge sharing and tacit knowledge sharing, and explicit knowledge sharing and tacit knowledge sharing are all positive impact on innovation behavior. Results further indicate that explicit knowledge sharing and tacit knowledge sharing play partial intermediary role in the relationship between Guanxi and innovation behavior.

articleTitle: Research on Mechanism of Transmission on Impact of Emergency to Chinese Stock Market Based on Heterogeneous Agent Model
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: The impact of the emergency on the stock market mainly performs at the variation of confidence of investors. The traditional financial theories consider that the direction of the variation is consistent, but it does not conform to the real situation of markets. This paper applied heterogeneous analytical approach which is based on behavioral finance to research the behavior of investors, then to construct the Heterogeneous Agent Model (HAM) of impact of emergency on Chinese stock market. In order to verify the conclusion of this model, this article selected the closing price of Shanghai Composite Index to estimate the parameters of HAM. Firstly, we constructed the multi-objective parameter optimization model. Secondly, we utilized the simulation method to study the different influences of internal characteristics of emergency on investor behavior and market performance. The simulation results showed that the internal characteristics of emergency had significant impact on investor behavior in Chinese stock market, and then affected the market performance after the outbreak of emergency.

articleTitle: An Exploration of Marketing Risks in Celebrity Business Ventures
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Recently, celebrities have enthusiastically created their own business. Although celebrity entrepreneurs think that their credibility would enhance the customer's purchase intention toward the products of their business ventures, this study find that the effect does not exist; the purchase intention relies mainly on a customer's brand attitude toward the venture which is influenced by the customer's perceived congruence between a celebrity and her/his business. Being a celebrity entrepreneur is therefore riskier than being a brand endorser.

articleTitle: A Research Framework of Conflict Complexity for Brownfield Redevelopment: A Social Network Perspective
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Game theory is commonly used in conflict research but few attentions were focused on conflict complexity from the perspective of stakeholders' social characteristics. This paper proposed a framework of conflict complexity with social network. The framework included two processes: 1) reviewing literature to establish a theoretical framework, and 2) employing the cases of brownfield redevelopment to demonstrate the feasibility. The results indicated the dynamic feature of social network structure as a consequence of the different roles of stakeholders, the influences of in-group preference as well as dissemination of information in the generation of conflict, and the scope and degree of conflict which were based on simulation analysis. The paper can fill the gap for improving the conflict governance in brownfield redevelopment.

articleTitle: Evolution of World Exports: Based on Mutualistic Environment within a Product Space
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Exploring the process of a country's development pattern is economists' long-term research problem. Most of the current research has been conducted by empirical research to analyze the relationship between economic growth and trade data. Hidalgo put forward the conception of product space and simulated the move of a country's exports' advantage within a product space. However, there exists some limitations in their research. And the purpose of the paper is to improve the product space and evolution model and to introduce the government policy into the model. The result shows that the policy for various types of exports will lead a country's subsequent economic growth into different convergence level, and therefore it is critical for a country to choose the appropriate development direction.

articleTitle: Passengers' Information Propagation in the Subway Emergency Based on SIRS Model
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: When the subway emergency occurs, the panic of passengers will extremely increase because of enclosed space of metro and the large population density, which may lead the spread of information faster and more complicated. The objective of this study is to investigate the process of passenger information dissemination under such circumstance. Based on the SIRS model and mean field theory, we develop a passenger information diffusion model. The model is modified to be suitable for passenger's habit that positive social reinforcement is considered. We simulate the rule of diffusion and analyze the trend of information variation by changing different parameters. The paper concluded with a discussion on some feasible advice on subway emergency management.

articleTitle: Authors Index
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Authors Index

articleTitle: Research on the Impacts of Internet on Knowledge Production Under the Dual Perspective of Technique and Institution
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Internet is not only a collective name of new generation of information technology, but also represents a new way of thinking and behavior preferences. This paper will bring the reduction of the production cost and knowledge sharing brought by Internet into the Rapoport's production and exchange model. We obtain the analytic solutions for improved Rapoport's production and exchange model under special circumstances (two kinds of products costs are the same). To analyze the influence of the productions of knowledge brought by Internet in knowledge innovation ecosystem, we discuss the numerical simulation results under more universal situation (two kinds of products costs are different). Research suggests that, 1) The key of knowledge production growth in an innovation ecosystem under the Internet background is the decreasing of production cost of knowledge brought by the Internet; 2) when the production costs of two kinds of knowledge is very close, there will be a symbiotic region. However, when the gap of production costs of two kinds of produces is large, then a “parasitic” state will exist under the equilibrium state.

articleTitle: Credit Evaluation Based on the Improved Super-Efficiency Method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: For internet finance companies, in order to differentiate good customers from bad customers, ranking and classifying customers according to credit scores is an important means to avoid risk. In the paper, an improved super-efficiency method is obtained and applied to evaluate the customers' credit in internet finance companies. In contrast to the super-efficiency method, computing results shows the improved method can really overcome two shortcomings of the original method: (1) relative efficiency values of some decision-making units are too large; (2) infeasibility problem can occurred in the original model. Furthermore, compared with other modified super-efficiency method, the improved method is simple. Data analysis illustrates that the improved method can rank and classify customers rationally. So the new method can provide feasible decision basis for risk management.

articleTitle: Constructing Strategy of Stable Reverse Military Logistics System Based on Non-Cooperative Game
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Establishing military reverse logistics system is propitious to dig out the value of equipment for the second time, increase the military and economic benefit. Based on the non-cooperative game theory, the paper advanced the static complete information game model of military reverse logistics system, researching the action of military reverse logistics players in different equilibrium condition, pointing out the common condition to establish steady military reverse logistics system, summarizing the strategy of army and enterprise. The study result has provided the theory dependence for doing military reverse logistics work and bringing up its stability.

articleTitle: A Study on Television Metadata Generation Process by Pro-Audience
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to analyze the generation process of television metadata on a commercial base. This study introduces the focused ethnography and observation of cases of the metadata. A decade ago, typically, the broadcast archive consisted of movies and indexes and metadata. Afterwards, additional text information on TV programs called “post metadata” appeared around the broadcasting industry in Japan. This study focuses on the metadata generation process in which contents of program are not only monotonously recorded in text, but also information based on needs is selectively recorded in text format with certain rules and ethical standards. There is a kind of knowledge filter in the generation process based on manual works by pro audience.

articleTitle: The Study on Influencing Factors of Urban Carbon Emissions in China: A Case of Harbin
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Under the New Normal context, China's government proposed requirements for national emission reduction, and such practice in cities is of great importance to achieve the goal of national environmental governance in 2030. This study selects Harbin as the typical case and investigates what factors affect the amount of its carbon emission by applying the STIRPAT model with the data from 1995 to 2015. The findings show that urban population, energy intensity, per capita GDP deflator, and the capacity of public transportation all positively affected the level of city's carbon emissions with a gradually decreasing influencing extent, while industrial structure did not significantly affected carbon emissions. Accordingly, to reduce carbon emissions in Harbin, residential living environment, energy efficiency, and the energy system of public transportation should be further optimized.

articleTitle: Innovative-Design Typology in Old-Building Renewal
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: This study aims to challenge traditional approaches to classifying innovative design by its typology through evidence from renewed old buildings in the public space. Using theoretical approaches, this study summarizes the characteristics of old-building renewal and reuse, and builds a foundation for further research on the theoretical evaluation of innovative design. In the theoretical part, we examine 12 examples from eight categories of innovative design, which are grouped into four types: function, aesthetics, technology, and context. Then, we explore the relationships between those four types and the geographical regions they are situated in. Finally, we try to find an innovation model between these four types. In future studies, we will focus on the theoretical evaluation of innovative design in the renewal of old buildings in each type.

articleTitle: Impact of Work Engagement and Innovative Work Behavior on Organizational Performance; Moderating Role of Perceived Distributive Fairness
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: The study aims to check impact of work engagement and innovative work behavior on organizational performance. It also aims to check the moderating role of perceived distributive fairness, and mediating role of innovative work behavior in these relationships. Data was collected from 208 employees of public sector organizations. Multiple regressions are using MODPROBE and PROCESS macros to verify the hypothesis. Results from the study indicated that work engagement has positive effect on innovative work behavior and organizational performance. Moreover, mediating effect of innovative work behavior and moderating role of perceived distributive fairness was also verified. Study was limited to public sector organizations only. Therefore, more research is needed to generalize the results in other contexts. Managers can gain competitive advantage through employee's innovative work behavior in cut throat competition.

articleTitle: Who Wants to Live Like a Local?: An Analysis of Determinants of Consumers' Intention to Choose AirBNB
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: As a new lifestyle, “Airbnb” is on its way to the proper nouns of the business model of “sharing economy” and gaining great popularity among the consumer groups of young people. Its marketplaces have flourished particularly in western countries, while in China it's not that popular. In this article, we aimed to explore the factors influencing consumer adoption of Airbnb using Extended Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT2) model. The results indicated that performance expectancy, social influence, hedonic motivation and price value were significant predictors of intention to use Airbnb, and consumers' trust was positively related to performance expectancy. Further, consumers' cross-cultural experience moderated the relationship between performance expectancy and behavior intention, and consumers' extroversion as well as change seeking tendency moderated the relationship between hedonic motivation and behavior intention. Theoretical and practical implications of the findings are discussed.

articleTitle: Establishing Standard Definition and Guidelines for Brownfields in Pakistan: A Stakeholder Perspective
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: In contrast to comprehensive guidelines for brownfield redevelopment in developed countries, no references can be found in current policies of Pakistan. The purpose of this paper is to conduct a comprehensive literature review of brownfields in developed countries, extracting key dimensions of brownfields definition in different countries, to develop a consensus based pioneer brownfield definition and propose redevelopment guidelines in Pakistan. Based upon the extensive literature review, Stakeholders perception and opinions were introduced to propose standard brownfields definition and a set of guidelines. Data collected through questionnaires and interviews enabled this study to conclude that more research is needed and policies should be devised to reach an agreement on pioneer brownfield definition. The proposed guidelines should be incorporated into existing urban land use policies. This research also pointed out that founding of brownfields database by responsible authorities is need of the hour, which is one of the major constraint to initiate brownfield redevelopment in Pakistan.

articleTitle: Research on Influencing Factors of Radical Technology Innovation-Based on Structural Equation Model
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: This paper defines the concept and connotation of radical innovation, and discusses the theoretical and practical significance of radical innovation. This paper analyzes the types and characteristics of radical innovation, and expounds the process and management mode of radical innovation. Based on the hypothesis of the relationship between the radical factor and the innovation performance, the hypothesis model of the relationship between the two is constructed, and the model and the correlation hypothesis are tested by using the structural equation model combined with the empirical data. The results show that the innovative culture, management flexibility, industrial cluster scale, innovation culture and the degree of internal fusion have a significant positive impact on the radical innovation. The conclusions of the study may provide reference and inspiration for enterprises to effectively implement improve radical innovation performance.

articleTitle: Competitive Evaluation of Internet Enterprises with Improved Radar Chart
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Internet is one of the most competitive industries in China. In order to fully understand the competitive status of China's Internet industry, the improved radar charts are used in this paper to evaluate the competitiveness of 49 Internet companies listed on NASDAQ. Improved radar charts can not only examine the weight of each index directly, but also can measure the balance of development by comprehensive algorithm effectively. It is found by this new method that about 27% of enterprises are in the upstream of this highly competitive industry, 67% in the middle and only 6% in the downstream. By K-means clustering analysis, about 75% of companies at the phase of growth are classified as “conservative” oriented, and 83% of mature ones are “growth” oriented. Moreover, the “aggressive” oriented company in the industry could go far than expectation.

articleTitle: A Study on the Relationship Between Corporate Culture and Corporate Environmental Performance
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Enterprises are an essential component of national economy, whose operation and business activities are closely related to environment issues. However, most enterprises in China are bound by environmental policies and regulations to live up to their environmental responsibility. This passive attitude of obedience can't play a good role in the improvement of environmental performance. This study constructs the model between corporate culture and corporate environmental performance, with the control variables of enterprise scale and enterprise property. In the part of empirical study, the qualitative and quantitative research methods are combined to verify the relationship between corporate culture and corporate environmental performance through analyzing the data of 127 manufacturing enterprises' culture. The results show that: (1) Two dimensions of corporate culture, ethical-social culture and emotional-developmental culture, have a positive effect on corporate environmental performance, while economic-practical culture doesn't have a positive effect on corporate environmental performance. (2) Environmental management practices can moderate the relationship between corporate culture and corporate environmental performance. Specifically, ISO certification of environmental management system will enhance the relationship between them. According to the results, this study offers suggestions for the improvement of corporate environmental performance on corporate culture construction and environmental management practices.

articleTitle: A Study on the Impact Mechanism of Team Faultlines on Team Performance ―Based on the Moderation Effect of Shared Objectives
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: More and more enterprise organizations adopt the form of team structure, and team faultlines has become an unavoidable problem in team management. This research constructs the theoretical model based on the relationship between team faultlines, team conflict, team performance and shared objectives. Based on the internal influence of team faultlines on team performance, two variables of team conflict and shared objectives are introduced. Team faultlines are divided into social categorization faultlines and information processing faultlines. The empirical results show that the social categorization faultlines and information processing faultlines have negative impacts on the team performance. The team conflict plays a mediation role in the process of the impact of the social categorization faultlines and the information processing faultlines on the team performance. The shared objectives plays a moderation role in the process of the impact of the social categorization faultlines and the information processing faultlines on the team performance. This research explores the mechanism of team faultlines on team performance, and according to the results proposed to some relevant suggestions to strengthen team management.

articleTitle: Research on R&D Innovation Efficiency of Regional High-Tech Industry Considering Spatial Effect
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: The stochastic frontier model is used to measure the R&D innovation efficiency of high-tech industry in 30 provinces in China during 2009-2015 and analyze the influence of spatial effects on the R&D innovation efficiency. The study found that the R&D innovation efficiency of regional high-tech industries have a big difference and a significant spatial correlation; innovation outputs show spatial effect which has significant positive impact on innovation efficiency; there is significant U type relationship between firm size and R&D innovation efficiency; government financial support has a significant negative impact on R&D innovation efficiency, government tax support has a significant positive effect on R&D innovation efficiency. Regional science and technology level and regional economic level have no significant effect on the R&D innovation efficiency.

articleTitle: Which Characteristic Portfolios Lead to Innovation?
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: At present, innovation has become a basic engine of social transformation, which not only directly influences the process and result of material production, but also indirectly affects staff values, codes of conduct and survival, and the latter more involved in corporate character. The corporate character in innovation plays an important role, and understanding the inherent relationship between organizational character and innovation can help enterprises achieve their performance. Therefore, this paper takes 185 listed companies of 2014-2016 years of high-tech industry as the sample, and studies the relationship between characteristic portfolios and innovation exploratory using financial and governance data, and meanwhile verifies that organizations can cultivate its own character traits from four aspects: organizational orientation, sound consciousness, internal decision-making and external perception. And corporate can use the characteristics of effective combination of elements to seek the overall upgrading of innovation, and then establish a sustainable competitive advantage.

articleTitle: Livestreaming for User Testing Context-Rich Observation of Game Player Behavior
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Game developers need methods for judging the effectiveness of their game designs. Although traditional user testing methods have been employed by the video game industry, they fail to capture players in their natural settings, indicating a more ethnographic approach could generate new insights into their behaviors. With the recent rise in popularity of livestreaming, this paper proposes that employing a “think-aloud” testing method over a livestream can be a useful addition to the testing tools available to developers and provide valuable contextual insights that could help game designers discover radical new innovations. By observing the livestreams for seven games, including two games created by one of the researchers, we discover that livestreaming not only exposes many of the design and product quality issues revealed by more traditional user testing, but that it also exposes many contextual behaviors that would otherwise remain hidden in a laboratory setting. This has implications not just for user testing within the video game industry, but for user testing in other industries desiring more contextual information about their consumers.

articleTitle: Service Improvement Based on E-Banking Adoption Model
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Following the experience economy era coming, in order to retain customers, we must focus on the user experience and so do banking industry. Experience is the core engine of the network financial. In this paper, we study e-banking service improvement with the breakthrough point of user experience. This paper bases on the technology acceptance model and refer to multiple technology acceptance extension model at the same time, to build and verify the electronic bank adoption model. It concluded the factors influencing the adoption of electronic banking services. Then we guide the design of the e-banking based on the theory of service contact and the factors that influencing electronic banking user adoption to improve the user experience, attract new users and improve customer loyalty. So that the electronic banking gains better development in the fierce competition.

articleTitle: The Effect of Supply Chain Collaboration on Innovation Performance: Moderating Effects of Resource Orchestration
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: In the context of application of open alliance innovation strategy, this study researches on the impact of supply chain vertical collaboration and horizontal co-opetition on organizational exploratory and exploitative innovation performance. In this paper, we use resource orchestration as contextual and explore their moderating effects. Collect date from 271 Equipment manufacturing enterprises in China to test the hypotheses by using empirical research. Using the method of hierarchical regression analysis, this paper finds the supply chain vertical collaboration is positively related to exploitative innovation performance, yet is bell-shaped related to exploratory innovation performance. Supply chain horizontal co-opetition is positively related to exploratory innovation performance. Moreover resource orchestration has moderating effects to supply chain and innovation performance. This study results helps broaden the theoretical perspective of supply chain collaboration and strengthen the research of supply chain collaboration and innovation performance.

articleTitle: Do Market Differences Influence Online Consumer's Behavior? An Investigation of Online Movie Reviews Usefulness Across Markets
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: This paper aims to investigate how does market differences influence consumers' behavior when reading online reviews. To this end, we propose a conceptual model from the perspective of content quality and source quality to explore the determinants of review helpfulness. We unravel that consumers' rating behaviors show differences in different movie markets. Using reviews data from IMDB.com and douban.com, we apply linear models to examine the cultural differences. The results demonstrate that there are significant differences across two different movie markets (China and US). Specifically, online reviews length, review extremity, reviewer centrality and reviewer experience have signal positive impact on usefulness of movie reviews. We found that long sentences and extreme sensibility can be more persuasive in individualist societies (US) than collectivist societies (China); while the effects of reviewer centrality and reviewer experience to review usefulness are inclined to be same in two markets. The findings give a better understanding of online reviewer behaviors across different markets and provide important insights into emerging movie markets such as China.

articleTitle: The Impact of Internal Co-Inventor Network on Innovation Performance-A Case of Chinese ICT Manufacturing Industry on Patent Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: The internal enterprise's innovation network is one of the important drivers of the drive organization's innovation performance. Based on the theory of social network, this paper analyzes the patent data of Chinese ICT listed companies from 2005 to 2014 with the help of negative binomial regression. We systematically and comprehensively analyze the effects of Chinese ICT listed company internal inventor cooperation network characteristics on innovation performance from three dimensions: network location, small world and cooperation intensity. The empirical results show that the relationship between betweenness centrality and innovation performance is inverted U-shaped, the same as the relationship between clustering coefficient and innovation performance; and the intensity of network cooperation has a positive effect on the innovation performance of enterprises. The structure hole has no a significant influence on the company innovation performance in the network location. The results of this article are of reference meaning for improving the innovation performance of ICT industry in China.

articleTitle: Can “Stay Online” Reduce Our Work Performance?
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Due to the prevalence of mobile devices, more and more people are getting used to switch among different electronic devices during work, such as computers, mobile phones, iPads. Some argue that the multitasking ability allows them to complete multiple tasks at the same time and improve work efficiency. As opposed to this type of view, other people think that due to the limited capacity of attention and memory, switching among different interfaces damages the performance of each individual task. However, simply staying online does not provide such severe consequence. In order to investigate the effect of “stay online” or switching among different electronic interfaces on performances, this study explored the effects of memory maintaining and updating by using the memory updating paradigm. The results showed that the maintenance of other objects delayed the process of memory updating. Moreover, as the number of items increased, users' performances were damaged along with increased reaction time and reduced accuracy. Interestingly, when the number of items maintained in working memory reached a certain level, participants' response time would no longer increase, and subjects could not switch among these items correctly either. These results indicated that only “stay online”, with the presence of other media, would reduce the work performance, but if users did not switch among different items, the impact of media numbers would not affect the efficiency of work. But due to the switching cost, if people need to switch among different media in the work, their performances must be damaged, which might result in extended working hours and increased errors.

articleTitle: Customer Churn Prediction in Chinese Traditional Broadcasting Industry: A Positive Analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: In order to better respond to market competition, national broadcast service providers such as cable network enterprises have to recognize customer preference and forecast customer churn intention before their rivals do so. In this paper, data recorded by the digital set-top box and consuming records in cable network's finance system is used for analyzing customer churn. First, the results of this research indicate that customer watching intensity, customer consumption amount and customer paying habits have significant influence on customer churn. And the effect of customer watching intensity on customer churn is moderated by customer watching preference. Second, this research uses logistic regression to build the prediction model. Finally, we propose different user retention strategies targeting the churn customers. This study demonstrates that our proposed user churn factors are efficient and capable of providing effective marketing strategies for cable network enterprises.

articleTitle: The Impact of Female Executive Characteristics on Corporate Donation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: With the continuous progress and development of society and modern business environment, female have played a more and more important role in the corporate governance. As an important component of corporate social responsibility, corporate donation has attracted more and more academic attention. In this study, we shed light on the relationship between female executives' characteristics and corporate donation. With a sample of all A-share listed companies spanning from 2010 to 2016, we investigate the impact of three key characteristics of female executives on corporate donation: education, age and pay. The empirical results show that the education of female executives is significantly correlated with the corporate donation, but female executives' age and the executive pay for female contribute little to the donation. Specifically, highly educated female executives are significantly associated with relatively low corporate donation levels. This paper enriches the branch of research of gender effects on corporate social responsibility, and our results carry practical implications for corporate governance, behavioral corporate finance, and human resources.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation of Collaborative Innovation Ability of Equipment Manufacturing Enterprises Based on Factor Analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: The equipment manufacturing industry is the basic and strategic industry which is related to the long-term interests of the country. Innovation ability is an important symbol to measure the comprehensive competitiveness of a country or region. In this paper, the evaluation index system of collaborative innovation ability of equipment manufacturing enterprises is constructed from three aspects: innovation input, innovation cooperation and innovation output. Then, the evaluation model is established by factor analysis method. In the empirical analysis process of the equipment manufacturing enterprises collaborative innovation ability, the panel data of eight industries in China's equipment manufacturing industry from 2009 to 2014 is used as the research sample, and makes a comparative study on the collaborative innovation ability within the equipment manufacturing industry. Finally, hope to provide the basis for enterprises to enhance collaborative innovation and develop more scientific and innovative decision-making.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation System of Enterprise's Scientific and Technological Innovation Capability: From the Perspective of Dynamic Capability
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Evaluation of enterprise's science and technology programs can provide the data for determining effective collocation of enterprise's resource, improve management of its innovation programs. Therefore, with the base of the research results and the theory of dynamic capabilities, this paper constructed the evaluation system that can reflect the dynamic adaptability of the firm scientific and technological innovation capabilities (STICs). By adopting the method of factor analysis and selecting 284 enterprises in Sichuan province as the research objects, this study finds that three dimensions, which are strategic indicators, development indicators and performance indicators, can be applied to construct the evaluation system. Besides, through the comprehensive ranking of factors, it finds some problems of those enterprises in the development of STICs. So this study provides a reference and guidance for enterprises to evaluate their STICs, and it could help the government and the firms in Sichuan to understand and enhance the firms' STICs.

Author Keywords: Enterprise's scientific and technological innovation ability

articleTitle: Analysis and Solution on the Problem of Resource Allocation Efficiency in China Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: As a core part of the modern market economy system, the financial market has a direct impact on the development of national economic construction. Based on Jeffrey Wurgler's Capital Allocation Efficiency Model and relying on the 2007-2014 data of A-share market, empirical research shows that China's resource allocation efficiency is low. The direct factors that affect the allocation efficiency of China's stock market are investor heterogeneity belief, agency cost and enterprise value. Through the multiple linear regression analysis, it is found that the investors' heterogeneous beliefs and agency costs have an inhibitory effect on the efficiency of resource allocation in China's stock market, while the value of the enterprises has played a catalytic role. Investors' heterogeneous beliefs have the greatest impact on stock market resource allocation efficiency. According to the results of the research, a scheme to solve the efficiency of stock market resource allocation is designed. The scheme puts forward the solution from weakening the government's administrative intervention, perfecting the stock market's market mechanism and strengthening the investors' judgment ability. At the same time, the scheme is analyzed from the viewpoints of feasibility, rationality and applicability.

articleTitle: A Study of Enterprise Innovation Performance Using the Theory of Structural Holes
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: The ability to generate a continuous stream of technological innovation has been more important than ever in allowing an enterprise to improve profitability and get sustainable development. It is a hot spot to analyze technology with social network analysis method, especially the analysis of patent technology networks. This study proposes a new approach to identifying the relationship between structural holes and innovation performance of enterprises from the perspectives of co-occurrence based on the theory of structural holes. Specifically, drawing from a sample of 46 enterprises listed in Fortune 500 companies which belong to the electronics industry over 15 years, the results from panel regression model provide support for the hypothesis. The aim at this study is to find out what kind of structural holes level can enable enterprises to obtain the best innovation performance. Thus, we can provide future direction for the development of technology companies. In addition, this study also provides new ideas and methods for the research of enterprises innovation performance.

articleTitle: Measuring Effects of Language Barriers on Knowledge Spillover from Scientific Journals
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Language barriers have a negative effect on knowledge spillover process. Scientific journals are main carrier of scientific knowledge, and the mutual citations between scientific journals depict the paths and directions of knowledge spillovers. This paper selects six Chinese scientific journals (three Chinese-language journals and three English-language ones) from three disciplines in Web of Science as samples, constructs journal citation networks respectively with JCR database, and compares network topology parameters and evolution process of these journals from 2005 to 2009. We establish a measurement model of knowledge spillovers by defining network topology parameters as substitutional variables to measure the impact of language barriers on knowledge spillovers. Finally, this paper proposes a suggestion on how to overcome negative effect of language barriers on Chinese scientific journals.

articleTitle: Measurement of Conceptual Innovation of Chinese Aerospace Enterprises its Influencing Factors
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: As concept innovation has a profound impact on enterprise innovation, however, no research has yet explores the dimensions of concept innovation and its influencing factors. To address this omission, this research conducts two studies. First, following the literature in measurement theory, study 1 introduces the construct of concept innovation, which comprises three dimensions: enterprise belief, innovative cognition and corporate culture. The scale shows internal consistency, reliability, construct validity and nomological validity. Study 2 mainly explores the influencing factors of concept innovation, according to the empirical research, the results show that Crisis awareness and risk acceptance willingness positively affect concept Innovation, while the organization inertia has a negative effect on concept Innovation.

articleTitle: Enterprise Knowledge Heterogeneity and Innovation Diffusion
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Innovation diffusion is increasingly considered to be the root of the overall economic growth and technological progress. The heterogeneity of enterprise knowledge will affect the understanding, absorption and utilization of enterprise knowledge and will affect the diffusion of innovation. This paper indirectly explores the effect of enterprise heterogeneity on innovation diffusion by taking knowledge sharing as a mediator in empirical research. Our findings suggest that the heterogeneity of enterprise knowledge has a significant positive effect on innovation diffusion, and knowledge sharing plays a partial mediating role in the relationship. This study provides a theoretical explanation and reference for enterprises to promote innovation diffusion by using heterogeneity knowledge.

articleTitle: Risk Analysis and Prevention in Mineral Resources Development Alliance Between China and ASEAN Companies: From the Perspective of China Companies
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: From the perspective of China companies, the risk identification, analysis and prevention of mineral resources development alliances (MRDAs) between China and ASEAN companies (CACs) are studied in this article. Based on the perspective of project management, the Grid Method is used to break down the risks of MRDAs between CACs. The risks of MRDAs are broken down into decision-making risks, formation risks, operation risks and disintegration risks from horizon; internal risks and external risks from longitude. Besides, the Modular Method and the Back Propagation Neural Network (BPNN) are used to identify and analyze the risks of MRDAs, respectively. The results show that: There are 23 specific risks in MRDAs between CACs; And based on a case of the Letpadaung Copper Mine project in Myanmar, these risks can be divided into five levels: high, medium high, medium, medium low, and low. Based on the above results, the risk prevention methods are presented: (1) According to the risk level, the corresponding prevention strategies are developed; (2) Chinese companies need to unite the Chinese government departments and local alliance partners to jointly prevent the risks of MRDAs. Among them, the Chinese government departments mainly prevent political risks; the others mainly prevent non-political risk; (3) For internal risk, the changes of internal key risk-induced factors need to be eliminated, controlled or mitigated as much as possible. For external risks, the changes of external key risk-induced factors need to be strictly monitored, and to develop corresponding responses. Finally, for the internal and external risks, the specific prevention strategies are proposed respectively.

articleTitle: Research on the Technological Innovation Performance of China's High-Tech Enterprise Based on DEA
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: This paper draws on the previous research results and divides the technological innovation process of high-tech enterprise into two stages: technology R&D and technology transformation. Then it constructs input-output evaluation index systems of two stages. Based on the efficient DEA model, this paper uses the related data of Chinese 27 provinces during 2012-2015 to analyze the technological innovation performance of high-tech enterprise. The results show that: The constructed DEA model can effectively solve the “black box” problem, and well calculate the technological innovation performance of high-tech enterprise. The technological innovation level of high-tech enterprise in different regions is uneven. In the most areas, high-tech enterprises put too much emphasis on intermediate achievements, and inadequate attention to the commercialization stage. Finally, this paper presents relevant policy implications according to the research.

articleTitle: A Quantitative Analysis of Strategic Leadership in Teamwork: Inspirations from the Case of the Game Named League of Legends (LOL)
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: The effect of strategic leadership on organizational performance has been a hot topic of research for decades, and the general consensus has been reached in recent years: strategic leadership is essential in organization growth and development in the complex and increasingly competitive environment. The purpose of this dissertation is to explore the relationship between characteristics of strategic leadership and organizational effectiveness. After analyzing the theory of the nature and mechanism of strategic leadership, this study was presented that since the decision made by the leader can only be implemented on condition that team members cooperate with each other to carry out the plan, the strategic leadership cannot directly influence the team effectiveness and vitality, therefore, the intermediary variable is supposed to be included to guarantee the plausibility of the hypothesis. The research has discussed that strategic leadership is mirrored from three aspects: leaders' qualities, organizational abilities and interaction abilities; and team members also need three processes from obtaining information to implementation: perception, listening and execution as a theoretical model to study the mechanism of strategic leadership. In this study, the league of legends team competition as a research case, the game players conducted a questionnaire survey. A total of 300 valid questionnaires were collected. The statistical analysis, correlation analysis and intermediary regression analysis were used in order to verify through empirical research all of the interactions between elements.

articleTitle: Does the Stakeholder Drive Knowledge Transfer in Innovation Ecosystem? -A View from Institutional Legitimacy Perspective
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: In order to reveal the innovative strategy of using innovation ecosystem cross-border resources under the big data dynamic and diversity context, the paper have investigate the relationship between knowledge transfer and stakeholder management strategies in innovative ecosystems from legitimacy perspective. Based on the data of 213 innovative enterprises embedded in 11 industries, the innovation ecosystem knowledge transfer will be affected by the exploration and exploitation stakeholders synergy interaction with technical legitimacies and management legitimacies. But the coefficient of interactive variable indicator performing different significantly compared with direct effective on the knowledge transfer activities from knowledge information aggregation, knowledge sharing and knowledge transmission efficiency. Different from the traditional management ties effect on innovate performance conclusion, this study found that the exploration stakeholder with technical legitimacies is quiet significantly impact on knowledge resources aggregation, knowledge sharing activities based on Big data landscape more emphasis the rapid of and knowledge transmission efficiency for match the dynamic, complex, diversity and quickness trend context, and the exploitation stakeholder with management legitimacies is significantly impact on knowledge transfer information aggregation, knowledge sharing and knowledge transmission activities to creative innovative performance, which is significance for entrepreneurship enterprises achieve innovative performance to create competitive advantage.

articleTitle: On the Comparison of a Team's Directed and Undirected Innovation Networks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: An innovation team is usually formed for a task in which the partners collaboratively commit to the same goals, and form knowledge-complementary and mutually accountable working relationships. Using a deep processing graphite R&D center as an example and collecting the data from the members' published papers in CPCI-S (Conference Proceedings Citation Index - Science), EI (The Engineering Index), and SCI(Science Citation Index) databases, we extract the cooperation and consultation relationships to construct the undirected and directed network. By analyzing the cohesion, connectedness of network subgroups and other measures, we show that when the R&D center is developing, subgroups are connected by the key members. Some members lead in internal cooperation while others excel in external communication. We also find that the team has an obvious hierarchy and appears fragile. Our research on the R&D center both increases our current theoretical knowledge and guides managerial practice.

articleTitle: Measuring Quality in the First House of Quality with Target-Oriented Multiattribute Preference Analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Quality is inherent in the Quality Function Deployment (QFD) and its building construct of house of quality. In QFD, customer needs are identified as inputs to the first house of quality and then transformed through several stages into various levels of parameters to design for quality. However, in most cases numerical measurement of quality is not appropriately deployed. An approach for measuring quality in the first house of quality is proposed in the paper using target-oriented multi-attribute preference analysis. Firstly, quality in the first house of quality is examined from the viewpoint of evaluated aggregate quality. Secondly, attributes are identified to measure the achievement of customer needs and customer expectations on attributes are defined according to their relevant sources. Thirdly, quality in the first house of quality is measured with target-oriented multi-attribute preference analysis. The application of the approach is demonstrated through demonstrating quality measurement of a simplified case of a commercial aircraft.

articleTitle: Experience-Centric Service Cooperation Strategies and Pricing Strategies in a Dual-Channel Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: With the rapid development of e-commerce, more and more manufacturers in dual-channel supply chains choose to cooperate with the retailer, who becomes responsible for providing experience service to customers. In our research, we use a Stackelberg game theoretic model to analyze the free- riding scenario and the service cooperation mechanism implemented by the manufacturer and the retailer to increase both of their profits. The retailer is responsible for providing service, and the manufacturer shares a part of that service cost. We provide the optimal pricing decisions and optimal service level, and we analyze the members' profit from service cooperation. Degree ratios for the service cooperation and the free-riding behaviors between two members are presented. We find that the manufacturer benefits much more and the profit of the retailer will be hurt as the degree ratio of free riding increases. However, when the degree ratio of service cooperation increases, the profits of both members will increase.

articleTitle: Study of Portfolio Optimization Model Based on Design-Free Estimation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of the financial field, Markowitz portfolio model has become more mature, and covariance matrix estimation stands out in the application of the portfolio model. The covariance matrix estimation deviation problem in the portfolio model has great influence on the optimal solution. In order to correct the deviation of the covariance matrix and reduce the influence of the dimension curse and time-varying problems on the results, in this paper, the Design -Free estimation method is applied for the first time in the portfolio optimization model. Specifically, the portfolio optimization model is built on the basis of Design-Free estimation. The advantage of Design-Free estimation method is that it has no limit condition for the sample randomness and the parameter structure of covariance matrix, and can ensure that the estimated covariance matrix is a non-singular matrix, which effectively improves the accuracy of estimation. The empirical results show that compared with the traditional model and the stochastic matrix M-P distribution estimation portfolio model, the portfolio model based on design-free estimation has higher return-risk ratio.

articleTitle: Relationship Analysis Between Investment and Industrial Structure
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Since China followed the policy of reform and opening, investment has been used to stimulate economic development excessively. And the irrational investment structure has led to the imbalance of industrial structure. As a result, there is overcapacity of low-level industry and effective supply shortage of high-quality products and services in China's supply side. In order to achieve sustained, efficient, high-speed growth, the core task of China's structural adjustment at the present stage is to promote supply-side reform. Under the background of supply-side reform, the reasonable and effective investment should be made around the five economic tasks of the implementation to capacity, to inventory, to leverage, and reducing costs and making up short board. The supply and demand effect of investment should be brought into full play in economic growth. Therefore, the purpose of optimizing the industrial structure can be achieved. In the face of new normal, new situation and new requirements, based on the data of 1991 to 2014, this paper applies co-integration test, Granger causality test and VAR model analysis to analyze the relationship between investment and industrial structure, and provides appropriate recommendations for the direction of industrial optimization and the policy choice of supply-side reform.

articleTitle: Research on the Measurement of Knowledge Diffusion Speed in Citation Networks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Knowledge diffusion speed has an important influence on knowledge innovation efficiency, especially in the field of science and technology. This paper analyzes the knowledge diffusion process and the connotation of knowledge diffusion speed, and uses the citation network as a model to describe the mechanism of knowledge diffusion. Along with the characteristics of citation itself, the topological parameters of citation networks are defined. By assigning citation lag as the weight of edges, the citation network becomes a sequential network. Based on these ideas, this paper embarks from the topological structure of the citation network, establishes the measurement indexes of knowledge diffusion speed from both an integral perspective and an individual perspective, and reports empirical research. Results show that integral knowledge diffusion speed measurement indexes can reflect the development speed and tendency of a research topic, while individual knowledge diffusion speed measurement indexes can reflect the contribution of a particular work to the development of a research topic. This paper provides new insights regarding the objective and reasonable evaluation of a research topic's evolution process and a scientific paper's value.

articleTitle: A New Systematic Method for Selecting Continuous Sampling Plan Based on the Boundary Feasible Plan for In-Control Process
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Continuous sampling plans (CSPs) are extensively adopted in manufacturing systems to improve outgoing quality as well as reduce inspection costs. Existing CSPs formulating inspection scheme with the maximum value of average outgoing quality limit (AOQL) contour neglect some feasible sampling plans for in-control process. A new systematic method, designated as dynamic continuous sampling plan (DCSP), is proposed for establishing boundary feasible inspection schemes and supplying all feasible inspection schemes for the practitioners.
