Selecting inspection scheme according to produce lot size and AOQL in CSPs leads to the complexity and perplexity for the practitioners. DCSP solves the problem by demonstrating the-bigger-the-better rule on sampling frequency for inspection scheme selection. In all CSPs, which interval CSPs can work effectively and when CSPs should be stopped are two pendent issues. DCSP successfully solves the two problems by the foundation of effective working interval and stopping rule. Unlike partial optimization in the literature, DCSP can incorporate all process control tools into a whole integer by these characteristics, such as effective working interval, stopping rule, et al to realize process quantitative and qualitative control. Simultaneously DCSP realizes closed-loop and in-process control by the natural estimator of the probability of non-conformance. The original definition of the probability of acceptance in CSPs is unsuitable for DCSP due to the different value of the probability of acceptance for the processes with same outgoing quality. The probability of acceptance in DCSP is redefined as accepting or rejecting the outgoing product flow according to average outgoing quality (AOQ). The effects of the parameters in DCSP are discussed. The results comparing DCSP with CSP-1 show the stability and controllability in outgoing quality for DCSP. A numerical example is given at last to verify the proposed method.

articleTitle: Dose the Difference in Driving Rules Matter for Security?
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Left-hand traffic (LHC) and right-hand traffic (RHC) are two different rules of road adopted by countries on account of native culture and history. This paper investigates into security of road rules from the perspective of safe distance and its explaining variable drivers' response time during changing lane and overtaking. Road traffic capacity model and safe distance model are proposed to calculate safe distance based on ellipse vehicle model given that traffic capacity, driver classification, and vehicle speed and size.58 subjects are divided into LHC and RHC group tested their eye fixation in 9 regions when overtaking by eye tracker which constitutes drivers' response time. Undertaken independent-sample T test, test results indicate RHC' s overtaking safe distance distinct from LHC and RHC has shorter response time and longer safe distance.

articleTitle: Study on the Impact of Institutional Environment on the R&D Behavior of Private Manufacturing Enterprises in China: An Empirical Analysis Based on World Bank's Survey Data
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Based on World Bank's micro survey data on Chinese private manufacturing enterprises, this study analyzed the impact of three dimensions (legal protection, market intermediaries' development, trust) of institutional environment on in-house R&D decision, R&D cooperation decision and R&D intensity of enterprises. Furthermore, this study made an in-depth analysis of the substitution impact of formal and informal institutions on enterprises' R&D intensity. The results showed that the promotion of legal protection level in one region could not only facilitate enterprises to participate in In-house R&D and R&D cooperation significantly, but also promote enterprises' R&D intensity. The development level of market intermediaries imposed a positive impact on enterprises' R&D intensity and their participation in internal R&D activities. The promotion of the trust level in one region had a positive effect on enterprises' R&D intensity and their participation in cooperative R&D activities. In areas where the development level of trust was low, enterprises were more dependent on legal protection and market intermediaries to carry out R&D activities; that is, formal institutions and informal ones could be substitutes for each other in influencing enterprises' R&D intensity.

articleTitle: Economic Study on the Haze Management of Coal Combustion in Northeast China in Winter
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: The haze weather in China's northeastern region is particularly significant in winter. To provide a healthy environment for the residents and promote healthy economic development, here we recorded the monthly change curves of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, PM2.5 and PM10 concentrations in multiple key cities of Northeast China, and compared those concentrations in heating seasons and non-heating seasons. Our results showed that winter heating significantly changed the concentration of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, PM2.5 and PM10. Furthermore, we performed a cause analysis focusing on the impact of winter coal burning on haze weather, which aimed at proposing a feasible haze control approach for the northeastern region in order to achieve the best effect of haze control with minimum cost.

articleTitle: Patient Satisfaction Research of Townships Hospitals in Cold Region of China Based on Structural Equation Modeling
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Medical resources are an important part of the basic public service facilities. For a long time, China's medical resources have been highly concentrated in cities, yet the medical service supply is relatively insufficient in rural areas. In the research, investigate the patients of 15 medical and health institutions of township level in cold areas through questionnaires, and reveal the influence factors on patient satisfaction. Conduct factor analysis for handling the influence factors on patient satisfaction through SPSS20.2, and adopt structural equation model to build the route to influence patient satisfaction through AMOS21.0. Sum up five common factors, including conditions of medical institutions, doctor service, nurse service, patient institutions and patient satisfaction. It is good in fitting of structural equation model. Conditions of medical institutions and doctor service have greater influence on patient satisfaction, and nurse service and patient information have relatively less influence. And it is strong in the correlation between conditions of medical institutions, doctor service and nurse service. The results indicate that the residents in towns and villages pay the most attention to the reputation of hospitals, the quality of medical staff, medical expenses, equipment and drugs. Advise grassroots hospitals to strengthen the conditions and construction of service abilities of health clinics in towns and townships, increase the proportion of essential drugs and adjust the compensation standard of NCMS so that it can attract the patients to go to health clinics in towns and townships through the advantages in price. Optimize human resource structure in medical institutions and consolidate the guidance of doctors in health seeking behaviors of residents.

articleTitle: Study on Free Riding Behavior in Rural Environmental Pollution Complaints
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: With the environmental pollution increasingly severe, the government has strengthened the intensity of environmental pollution treatment. But to the government, the rural environment monitoring is difficult to supervise and plan, so the rural residents supervise the environmental pollution situation around them, and stop pollution behavior become another important force to control pollution. Because of the environment belongs to public goods, generally there is “free riding idea” in the rural residents, when they plagued by environment pollution. And then form a Free Riding Problem, all the rural residents suffering from environmental pollution, but there are no one to complain the pollution. This paper will study the free riding problem in the environmental pollution complaints through the experimental economics research method, analyze the influencing factors how to influence free riding behavior, according to the various influencing factors to design free riding experiments. Using descriptive statistical analysis method and empirical analysis method to analyze the experimental data. According to the experimental results, this paper summarizes the factor that can effectively reduce the free riding behavior when rural residents complain the pollution, and gives policy recommendations to relative departments.

articleTitle: The Influence of Interdependence and Value Co-Creation on Relationship Quality
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Based on the resource dependence theory and value co-creation theory, this paper puts forward a theoretical model of the relationship between interdependence, value co-creation and relationship quality and explores moderating role of market environment. The findings show as follows: Interdependence has positive influence on value co-creation and relationship quality; Value Co-creation has positive influence on relationship quality; Market environment plays regulatory roles. Finally, marketing suggestions for enterprises are provided after analysis and discussion. The disadvantages and trend of future research are also mentioned.

articleTitle: Study on the Causes of Social Stability Risk of Environmental Engineering Project-Based on Qualitative Comparative Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: In recent years, as China's faster economic development, environmental engineering projects due to social needs and increased risk also will be normalized. In 2014, the Blue Book of Chinese Society pointed out that in recent years, the number of social events caused by various social contradictions was more than 10,000<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. Where the environmental mass incidents are multiple with 30% annual growth. In all kinds of environmental conflicts, environmental engineering projects conflicts are emerging. The academic community has gradually carried out the construction of major projects of social stability risk assessment criteria, evaluation index system and other attempts to standardize the implementation of the project research, and achieved more fruitful research results. Local governments have been working in practice based on the corresponding evaluation index system. It is found that the establishment of environmental engineering project evaluation criteria is very important. However the root causes of social stability risk are essential for solving the fundamental problems. In the transition period, Chinese scholars are having great concern to the causes of the conflict. The scholars believe that with the consciousness of people's environment, the awakening and strengthening of citizens' consciousness, the lack of interest demands, the deviation of risk cognition, the influence of psychological perception and so on Important reasons for the frequent conflict of environmental engineering projects. From the theory used in the analysis, there are political opportunity structure theory, collective action theory, discourse theory, relative deprivation theory[2]. Some scholars believe that the occurrence of mass incidents (collective action) is an important factor in the environmental engineering as a social engineering, embedded in the local community, did not take into account the local knowledge, local identity, the impact of factors<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[3]</sup>. Therefore, in order to solve the analytical bias and selectivity bias caused by empirical data and case studies, this paper analyzes the multivariate independent variables by qualitative comparative analysis (QCA) (Ragin 1987, 2000)

articleTitle: The Synergies Between the Sustainable Development Goals and the Almaty Ccity Development Master-Plan
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: organisational aspects; innovation management; regression analysis; decision making; government policies; Internet; consumer behaviour; risk management; statistical analysis; manufacturing industries.

articleTitle: Does Size Determine the Efficiency of Clustered-Firms?-Evidence from Chinese Science Parks Over a Decade
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: In this study, we examine the factors which influence the efficiency of firms located in different clusters, and analyze the underlying mechanisms of it. Our sample contains data on more than 10,000 firms from 2005 to 2015 in Zhongguancun Science Parks in Beijing, China. Using the DEA model, we calculate the efficiency of each firm over time. It turns out that firm size has a strong negative relationship with firm's R&D efficiency, but a strong positive association with firm's commercial efficiency. Our study supplements the current knowledge by exploring the relationship between ownership and R&D efficiency which is also contingent on firm size. Then we found that the relationship between age of geographic clusters and R&D efficiency is also contingent on firm size. Discussions and analyses are given to these findings. Both managerial and academic implications are presented for further study.

articleTitle: Conflicts of Sustainable Development Projects in China
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Sustainable development projects play an important role in the improvement of the living condition of people. This research takes eight sustainable development projects located in a medium-sized city in China as case study to investigate the conflicts of sustainable development projects with external stakeholders during construction stage. A total of 25 experts are invited for semi-structured interviews. As a result, there are 13 types of conflicts identified linking to five groups of external stakeholders of the projects. The causes and solutions of these conflicts are also generated by interview survey. Suggestions are provided for conflict prevention and resolving of identified conflicts. The research result will benefit the researchers and practitioners of sustainable development project management in the better understanding and management of project conflicts.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on Green Innovation Capability Evaluation of China's Manufacturing Enterprises Based on Principal Component and Cluster Analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: In this paper, twelve indicators related to green innovation capability of China's manufacturing enterprises are selected and green innovation capability of twenty-five industries in China's manufacturing industry in 2014 is evaluated and sorted by principal component analysis method. Then the green innovation ability of the industry and enterprise is divided into three categories according to the similarity by using cluster analysis. Finally, the results of principal component analysis and cluster analysis are compared and analyzed. The research shows: The transportation equipment manufacturing industry and electrical machinery and equipment manufacturing industry belong to the high green innovation ccapability of the industry as the first category; chemical fiber manufacturing, general equipment manufacturing industry, ferrous metal smelting and rolling processing industry, equipment manufacturing, non-ferrous metal smelting and rolling processing industry and the agricultural food processing industry belong to middle green innovation capability of the industry as the second categories; the rest of the industry belong to the low green innovation capability of the industry as the third categories.

articleTitle: Institutional Entrepreneurship Strategy, Network Structure and Legitimacy—Case Study Based on Third Party Payment
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: As China's various industries to develop faster, there is lagging regulatory. Based on the perspective of entrepreneurial network, this paper makes an in-depth discussion on the influencing factors of the choice of institutional entrepreneurship strategy and the internal mechanism of institutional entrepreneurship strategy and legitimacy. This paper follows the theory sampling principle and selects the case study of Alipay and TenPay. It will explain how the strategy affects the network structure characteristics, and how the network structure affects the legitimacy of the network structure. The paper puts forward a theoretical model of institutional entrepreneurial strategy, network structure and legitimacy.

articleTitle: What is the Value of the Online Retailer's Demand Forecast Information Sharing?
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Online retailers consider history clicks when forecasting product market demand. Assuming that online retailers can forecast the market demand accurately, this study focuses on the supply chain composed of one online retailer and multiple suppliers When online retailer determining the order quantity, the quantity of maximum inventory is decide by the method of “current demand and safety stock” instead of “the average of historical demand and safety stock”,this study investigates the influence of the market demand information sharing of online retailer to the bullwhip effect on supply chain and the level of the supplier inventory. The results prove that the market demand information sharing of online retailer can reduce the bullwhip effect on supply chain, and can also reduce the inventory level of supplier. In addition continuous cycle demand correlation is the most significant impact that can influence the value of information sharing.

articleTitle: The Impacts Mechanism of Controlling System in Hospital on Quality of Care: From Process and Outcome Perspectives
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Considering complex environment of hospital, the implementation of information systems occurs lots of obstacles which impairs its effectiveness and efficiency in medical process. In other words, there exists lots of poor interactions between human and information system use, such as the overload work volume and medical errors resulting from inappropriate behavior with new technology. Thus, we use quality control system, an augmented system of electronic medical records, to explore the complementary impacts of information system to enhance the effectiveness of information system us. Our study extracted physicians' scores evaluated by the controlling system automatically at a large urban hospital in China. To examine relationship between controlling system and healthcare organizational outcomes, we construct the fixed effect model. Our results reveal an interesting progression over time in how process standardization forming from controlling system affects physician performance and patient benefits. Our findings contribute to both theoretical and practical Implications, in particular the new insight of behavior change in healthcare and policy directions.

articleTitle: The Stigmatization Risk Effect and Governance in the Network New Media: A Case Study of the Death of Yang LEI
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: The 21 century is a network era, nowadays the booming new Internet media has spawned Chinese group network public crisis one after another, especially stigmatization caused by the frequent public network opinion, and most of the incidents are generally long-term concerned by the public, including some widely criticized issues that involve public confrontation with the government. Once an event exposes, it will spread immediately and attract the public attention;then in a short time hyping the related event with stigmatization makes it be a hot topic and evolve into group network public crisis. Based on the research results of Chinese and foreign scholars on the stigmatization, this paper attempts to analysis the spread of the “death of Yang LEI” in the context of big data combined with the specific situation of China's current transition period. The study observes the context of the incident, real-time tracking of the latest developments in the event, accurate positioning of the storm eye public opinion and the views of leaders. This paper explains the causes, processes and social risks of stigmatization in social interaction, and points out the breakthrough of the panoramic governance of social risks caused by stigma. Hoping to be accepted by social managers, and look forward to being applied to the framework of social risk control measures.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Relationship Between Institutional Logic, Temporary Employment Behavior and Firm Performance
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: Based on the theory of institutional logic, this paper explores the relationship between institutional logic, temporary employment behavior and corporate performance by using The Peoples Republic of China 2012 Enterprise Surveys Data as a sample empirical study. According to the previous literature combing, the behavior of the Chinese enterprise is mostly influenced by the market logic and the temporary employment behavior, a negative impact on the annual performance of the enterprise;(2)the state logic have both positive and negative impact on the temporary employment behavior, a positive impact on the annual performance of the enterprise; (3) Temporary employment scale plays a part of mediating between institutional logic and corporate annual performance, and have a negative impact in the annual performance of enterprises.

articleTitle: Impacts on IPO Underpricing by the Information Disclosure of Intellectual Property- Empirical Study on SME and ChiNext Board Market of Shenzhen Stock Exchange in China
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering (ICMSE)
abstract: This paper investigated the quality of disclosure among the IPO companies on the Shenzhen SME and ChiNext board market in 2011 through three progressive indices that whether IP information was disclosed, fully disclosed and the amount disclosed. We also empirically researched the relationship between the disclosure of different IP information, the underpricing rate on the first listing day of IPO and the cumulative abnormal return in 20 trading days for the sample of IPO companies by multivariate regression analysis method. The result showed that whether the IP information was disclosed and fully disclosed were significantly negatively correlated with the underpricing rate of IPO, but no correlation with the amount disclosed and cumulative abnormal return in 20 trading days. Therefore, the suggestion for regulators and listed companies to pay attention to standard full disclosure of IP information was presented.
